title: Git & GitHub from zero
description: Go from never having used Git to pushing your projects to GitHub and unlocking free pro tools as a student.
outcomes: Explain what Git and GitHub are, and why every developer uses them
Push any project to GitHub from VS Code
Get the GitHub Student Developer Pack approved

steps.note: The big picture first: what Git and GitHub actually are (in Hindi).
Install Git, set it up and upload your first project.
Claim free pro tools with your student ID.
Switch on Copilot in VS Code with your student benefits.
